From plan to delivery

How the work
comes together.

Plan for everyday editing

We review your content, brand and current setup. Together, we choose the pages and features you need and confirm the fixed project price.

Build the pages

We create consistent templates, add the required features and review the main pages with you. Reusable sections help keep the site organised.

Prepare your team

We check key actions and show your team how to update the content. We also explain the care and support options available after launch.

Before we start

Good questions.
Straight answers.

Answers before we get started.

Does every WordPress project use Elementor?

We use Elementor when it suits the site and the people editing it. We can also work with an existing WordPress setup or custom code, depending on the project.

Can you keep my current content and branding?

Yes. We can build around your logo, colours and existing content. We review what needs to move or change before confirming the migration work.

Are updates and maintenance included?

Your proposal explains the support included after launch. Ongoing updates, maintenance and new features can be quoted separately.
